incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: INC-9876 (High) — service: inference-serving-prod. Escalation policy: inference-main. Primary on-call notified.
jeff: I didn't get the page on my phone — it looks like DND. Anyone ack?
maya: I see two nearly-identical incidents in PD, timestamps ~2s apart. Looks like the webhook retried and created duplicates.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-9876 created at 2024-06-08T20:20:34Z. Escalation: primary -> secondary -> manager. Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-9876
lina: I'm taking secondary. joining bridge now.
jeff: manager page also fired to @mike (shouldn't have happened). I still haven't been able to ack because my app shows two incidents.
maya: Confirming — PD shows re-escalation to manager at 20:21:10Z even though secondary ack happened at 20:21:05Z. Race window from duplicate creates.
sre-bot: Log excerpt: ```
ERROR inference-runtime: kv-cache timeout
2024-06-08T20:20:30Z request handler failed status=500 path=/pd/events
2024-06-08T20:20:31Z webhook retry attempt=1 status=500
```
maya: The webhook endpoint returned 500s for a short burst; PD retried and created a second incident instead of deduping.
jeff: Customer impact: metrics show ~12% of requests in us-west-2 had elevated latency/5xx for ~2 minutes. No external tickets yet.
lina: Bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident-9876 — I'll run initial mitigation. mute noisy PD alerts for 15m while we stabilize.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation event recorded — secondary -> manager at 2024-06-08T20:21:10Z (policy inference-main).
jeff: The root cause seems to be webhook errors + PD retry semantics causing duplicate incident creation and out-of-order ack processing.
maya: Short-term actions: 1) mute/ack duplicate incidents 2) disable webhook retries on PD integration (temp) 3) add idempotency header to PD event receiver to dedupe by incident key.
lina: Done: muted inference-serving-prod alerts in PD for 15m and acked the duplicate. Monitoring for noise.
jeff: I'll create a postmortem ticket and assign to @lina and @maya. Also add runbook step to verify PD dedup keys during deploys.
maya: Patch to receiver queued: add X-PD-Dedup header handling + ignore repeated create events within 10s window.
sre-bot: Reaction :thumbsup:
